name: Magnet-TS-TW
title: Magnet Effect
description: Wraps anything so it leans toward the pointer when it comes within a set distance, scaled by a strength you choose, and eases back to rest once the pointer moves away.
use: A hero or feature row should feel alive and invite the pointer without asking for a click.
avoid: Touch devices, where there is no hover, and dense layouts where items shifting feels unstable.
a11y: The pull is pointer-only with no reduced-motion fallback, and every instance listens to window pointer moves. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three items sit in a row on black: a white pill reading "Hover me", a square outlined tile holding a white sparkle, and a small outlined card with a title and hint line. When the pointer comes near, an item slides a little toward it.
behaves: A pointer listener measures each item against its centre plus a padding zone; while the pointer is inside that zone the item translates toward it in proportion to the distance, and once outside it eases back to its spot.
customise: Wrap any element as children; padding radius, magnet strength, disabled state, active and inactive transitions and wrapper class names are props.
weight: light: A window pointer listener and one transform transition per wrapped item.
demo: A button reading "Hover me", a sparkle tile and a card titled "Magnetic card" with "Move your cursor near me"
issues: The gaps between items change as each one moves, so the row visibly loosens while the pointer is near.
polishWhy: Movement is smooth and restrained; the shifting gaps make the row feel loose.
